title: AI Engineer
description:
Job Description

For years, Abbott’s medical device businesses have offered technologies that are faster, more effective, and less invasive. Whether it’s glucose monitoring systems, innovative therapies for treating heart disease, or products that help people with chronic pain or movement disorders, our medical device technologies are designed to help people live their lives better and healthier. Every day, our technologies help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes.

  
  
  

Abbott currently has an opportunity forAI Engineer. The **AI Engineer** will be responsible for working on complex problems in the field of life-saving implantable medical devices. He or she will use machine learning, artificial intelligence, statistical modeling, data mining, and visualization techniques to provide analytics solutions to a wide range of challenging projects.  As a key leader on the team, the candidate will develop solutions to curate and analyze large quantities of medical data.  The candidate will work on projects that provide solutions to internal and external stakeholders. The candidate will collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams in India and the US.  He or she will present solutions and insights in a concise and effective manner to technical and non-technical audiences.

  
  
  
  
Responsibilities

* undefined
* Standardize, curate, and extract deep insights from complex clinical datasets
* Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI, ML, and GenAI applications on the Databricks platform.
* Automate repetitive business processes, analytics workflows, reporting, and operational tasks using notebooks, workflows, jobs, and AI agents.
* Build and operationalize machine learning and Generative AI solutions using MLflow, Model Serving, Mosaic AI, and MLOps best practices.
* Design scalable and maintainable solution architectures integrating Databricks with enterprise data sources and business applications.
* Develop reusable APIs, libraries, notebooks, and frameworks to accelerate AI solution development.
* Optimize AI applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and infrastructure cost.
* Build and maintain robust data pipelines, orchestration workflows, and deployment pipelines within the Databricks ecosystem.
* Monitor production of AI applications, models, and workflows to ensure reliability, governance, security, and compliance.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities within the Databricks ecosystem to improve productivity and business value.
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end AI products.
* Drive AI engineering with best practices, code quality, testing, documentation, and reusable solution patterns.

  
Minimum Experience/Training

* undefined
* Minimum 4 years of work experience required, preferably working on GenAI focused projects
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or science field (example: biomedical engineering, biotechnology, bioinformatics, biostatistics or similar) with a demonstrable focus on programming and data analysis
* Familiarity with at least one programming language (Python, PySpark, SQL, R)
* Knowledge of at least one database software preferable but not required (Databricks/SQL)
* Familiarity with AI tools

  
  
WHAT WE OFFER  

At Abbott, you can have a good job that can grow into a great career. We offer:

  
  

* **Training and career development**, with onboarding programs for new employees and tuition assistance
* **Financial security** through competitive compensation, incentives and retirement plans
* **Health care and well-being programs** including medical, dental, vision, wellness and occupational health programs
* **Paid time off**
* **401(k)** retirement savings with a generous company match
* **The stability of a company** with a record of strong financial performance and history of being actively involved in local communities

title: Data Science Engineer 3
description:
**Job Title**

  
  
Data Science Engineer 3

**Business Environment**

  
  

Joining Amadeus means shaping the technology that keeps airports and airlines moving for millions of travelers every day. Our department, Airport and Airline Operations (AirOps), is the leading industry platform in airline and airport operations, delivering seamless and personalized passenger experience, an optimized airport operation, and automated disruption resolution between airlines, airports, border, and air traffic control.

  
  

Within AirOps Engineering in Bangalore (TRU-AOP-ENG), the FBR team [Flight Management, Baggage Reconciliation and Ramp operations] works closely with engineering, product and data colleagues across Amadeus sites worldwide. It delivers solutions for efficient and optimized airport and airline operations.

  
  

In FBR you will work on AI solutioning that has a visible impact on airline and airport operations.

  
  

·       Meaningful work applying generative and agentic AI to real operational challenges in the travel industry.

  
  

·       Modern, cloud-native technology and the chance to influence architecture and engineering practices.

  
  

·       Continuous learning, with exposure to emerging AI technologies and opportunities to grow your expertise.

  
  

·       A collaborative, inclusive culture that values diversity, flexibility and work-life balance.

  
  

**Summary of the Role : AI Engineer**

  
  

As an AI Engineer in FBR, you will join a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, data engineers, data scientists, product specialists and designers building the next generation of AI-powered solutions for airport and airline operations. The team develops cloud-native services with modern frontend and backend technologies, with a strong focus on production-grade AI agents and AI advisors.

  
  

You will combine deep expertise in generative and agentic AI with solid machine learning and MLOps foundations to design, develop and deploy scalable, AI-driven solutions. Working autonomously within defined processes, you will turn real business problems into reliable, secure and cost-efficient AI capabilities that operate at production scale.

  
  

**Your Main Responsibilities**

  
  

·       Own the design, development, deployment and maintenance of GenAI-powered solutions that support analytics and aviation operations, including new AI accelerators.

  
  

·       Implement and produce GenAI and agentic workflows using cloud-native technologies, primarily Microsoft Azure within a multi-cloud strategy, integrating them with existing data platforms and operational systems.

  
  

·       Build and maintain scalable APIs and backend services for conversational interfaces, tool-calling agents and AI-assisted analytics features, with close attention to latency, cost and reliability.

  
  

·       Design and develop scalable AI/ML solutions for real business problems, building and deploying predictive and optimization models on structured and unstructured data.

  
  

·       Drive the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from data preparation, training and validation through deployment and monitoring, ensuring model performance, scalability and reliability.

  
  

·       Apply Responsible AI principles throughout delivery, including security, data privacy, compliance and transparent handling of model limitations.

  
  

·       Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers and share best practices across the team.

  
  

·       Stay current with advances in AI/ML and generative AI, and drive innovation by evaluating new techniques and tools for FBR use cases.

  
  

·       Deliver within Agile/SAFe ways of working, adapting to changing customer-driven needs.

  
  

**Technical Responsibilities**

  
  

·       Design and orchestrate agentic AI systems (for example with LangGraph or Agent Development Kit), including tool calling, memory and multi-step reasoning, and the supporting infrastructure from concept to deployment.

  
  

·       Contribute to the design and optimization of AI context management, covering embeddings, retrieval (RAG), prompt construction and caching, so that AI experiences are fed with reliable, compliant data.

  
  

·       Establish LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrails, including offline and online evaluation, completeness and safety checks, and iterative improvement driven by real usage.

  
  

·       Optimize cost and latency of AI workloads through model selection, token and context budgeting, caching and efficient serving patterns.

  
  

·       Build and integrate data pipelines and deploy ML/DL models (regression, classification, clustering, NLP, deep learning) with TensorFlow, PyTorch or Scikit-learn into production systems.

  
  

·       Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for ML, experiment tracking, model versioning, reproducibility, and appropriate evaluation metrics and tuning.

  
  

·       Ensure end-to-end observability of AI services through logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting, and troubleshoot data and model issues in production.

  
  

·       Leverage Azure (and where relevant AWS or GCP) for AI/ML workloads, using serverless containers, event-driven architectures and API gateways.

  
  

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence**

  
  

·       Collaborate with Product Owners, Data Engineers and cross-functional product, engineering and business teams.

  
  

·       Translate business problems into data-driven AI solutions with clear success criteria.

  
  

·       Communicate insights, model outcomes and technical decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  
  

·       Build alignment across stakeholders through data-backed approaches.

  
  

**About the Ideal Candidate**

  
  

**Must have**

  
  

·       Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

  
  

·       6+ years of experience in AI/ML development and deployment.

  
  

·       Hands-on experience shipping GenAI solutions to production: prompt design, orchestration, RAG (e.g. Azure AI Search), evaluation frameworks, monitoring and iterative improvement from real usage.

  
  

·       Experience designing and orchestrating agentic AI systems (e.g. LangGraph, Agent Development Kit) from concept to deployment.

  
  

·       Strong Python (preferred) or Java/Scala, with good engineering practices: testing, code reviews and documentation.

  
  

·       Solid grounding in ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), statistics, probability and data modeling.

  
  

·       Experience with large datasets and distributed computing.

  
  

·       Solid cloud experience, preferably Azure (serverless, containers, event-driven architectures, API gateways, logging and monitoring), and MLOps practices.

  
  

·       Working knowledge of Responsible AI, security and data-privacy requirements for AI systems.

  
  

**Nice to have**

  
  

·       Aviation, airline or airport operations domain knowledge.

  
  

·       Experience with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry.

  
  

·       Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool-calling patterns.

  
  

·       Experience with vector databases.

  
  

·       Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes.

  
  

·       Azure AI certifications.

  
  

·       Experience working in Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).

  
  

**Soft skills**

  
  

·       Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work autonomously within defined processes.

  
  

·       Clear, confident communication in English, both written and verbal.

  
  

·       Thrives in a multi-cultural, global organization and adapts readily to changing, customer-driven needs.

  
  

·       Collaborative mindset, curiosity and a willingness to mentor and share knowledge.

  
  
  
  
  

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  
  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  
  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

  
  
  
  
  
  

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  
  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.

  

**Role Details**

**Key responsibilities include**:

**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.

* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.

* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.

title: Lead Research Engineer - LLM Optimization & Agentic Systems
description:
**Company:**
CraftifAI

**Work arrangement:**
Full-time, work from office

**Role focus:**
70% hands-on research and engineering; 30% technical leadership and ownership

**Preferred joining timeline:**
Candidates who can join in fewer than 45 days are preferred.

About CraftifAI

CraftifAI is building
**Orbit**
, a platform that automates engineering workflows across embedded software, Edge AI, and FPGA development. Our work connects requirements, domain knowledge, code generation, testing, validation, and deployment to help engineering teams build working products.

We are looking for a research-driven engineer who can strengthen the LLMs and agentic systems behind these workflows, with a particular focus on efficient on-premises deployment and reliable code generation.

About the Role

You will lead the research and implementation of domain-specific LLM solutions and agentic systems for engineering applications. This includes fine-tuning models, reducing their deployment footprint while preserving measured task quality, designing knowledge architectures, building agent harnesses, and establishing rigorous product benchmarks.

This is a
**hands-on technical leadership role**
. Approximately 70% of your time will involve coding, experiments, model optimization, evaluation, and product integration. The remaining 30% will involve architecture decisions, research direction, mentoring, and ownership of technical outcomes.

You should be comfortable moving from a research hypothesis to an implementation, measuring its impact, understanding its failures, and improving it until it works reliably within the product.

What You Will Own

1. LLM Fine-Tuning and Efficient On-Premises Deployment

* Adapt LLMs for engineering tasks, including code generation, tool use, debugging, and reasoning over domain-specific information.
* Build data preparation and fine-tuning workflows using suitable approaches such as supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, and preference optimization.
* Apply and evaluate compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to reduce model size and memory requirements.
* Measure trade-offs between task quality, model footprint, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost on target deployment hardware.

2. Agentic Systems for Code Generation

* Design and implement agent harnesses for task planning, repository exploration, context management, code generation, tool execution, debugging, and iterative correction.
* Build reliable execution flows with clear state management, failure recovery, stopping conditions, and observable results.
* Improve the ability of agents to complete engineering tasks across multiple files, dependencies, tools, and execution environments.
* Own the integration of these capabilities into CraftifAI’s product workflows.

3. Domain Knowledge and Context Architecture

* Design knowledge systems that connect source code, requirements, architecture documents, hardware documentation, SDKs, APIs, and previous engineering outcomes.
* Develop effective retrieval and context construction using approaches such as hybrid search, reranking, structured knowledge, and repository-aware retrieval.
* Decide when information belongs in model training, retrieval, structured tools, or persistent agent memory.
* Keep retrieved information traceable to its source, version, and applicable hardware or software configuration.

4. Code Quality and Automated Verification

* Build and integrate static analysis tools, compiler diagnostics, linters, code structure checks, and security checks into agent workflows.
* Combine these checks with automated builds, unit tests, and controlled execution to evaluate generated code.
* Convert tool findings into actionable feedback that agents can use to diagnose and correct their outputs.
* Establish quality gates and regression checks that provide objective evidence of improvement.

5. Low-Latency System Design

* Profile and optimize the complete workflow, including retrieval, context preparation, model inference, tool calls, and correction cycles.
* Improve serving, caching, batching, context efficiency, and execution routing where they produce measurable benefits.
* Design for practical on-premises constraints, including available compute, GPU memory, concurrency, and restricted external connectivity.
* Optimize time to a verified result alongside model response time.

6. Reasoning and Learning from Field Use

* Improve agent planning, tool selection, debugging, and recovery through systematic failure analysis and controlled experiments.
* Turn field failures and user feedback into curated datasets, evaluation cases, improved knowledge, and better agent behavior.
* Evaluate suitable methods for improving reasoning and tool use, including fine-tuning, preference learning, and reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Validate improvements against regression benchmarks before release, within customer data and deployment constraints.

7. Product Benchmarking and Technical Leadership

* Own reproducible benchmarks at both model and complete product workflow levels.
* Measure task completion, functional correctness, static analysis findings, test results, human intervention, latency, memory use, and compute cost.
* Use held-out tasks, baseline comparisons, ablation studies, and error analysis to explain which changes improve the product and why.
* Define research priorities, lead architecture and code reviews, mentor engineers, and take ownership from experimentation through product integration.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* **Minimum qualification: MS by Research from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad**
  , in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a closely related field.
  **A PhD is preferred.**
* Strong practical experience fine-tuning LLMs and deploying them on private or on-premises infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience reducing model size or inference memory requirements, supported by measured quality and performance results.
* Deep hands-on experience building agentic systems for code generation, including tool integration, execution feedback, and iterative repair.
* Strong understanding of domain knowledge architecture, retrieval systems, context management, and their interaction with model behavior.
* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with practical experience using frameworks such as PyTorch, Transformers, PEFT, or equivalent tools.
* Experience integrating static analysis, build systems, automated testing, or other programmatic checks into code-generation workflows.
* Strong research discipline: clear hypotheses, controlled experiments, reproducible results, and careful interpretation of failures.
* Ability to make architecture decisions, communicate technical trade-offs, and personally implement critical parts of the solution.

Additional Experience We Value

* Research publications or open-source contributions in efficient LLMs, code models, reasoning, agentic systems, or program analysis.
* Experience with C/C++, embedded software, compilers, firmware, or hardware-aware code generation.
* Experience with model serving, inference profiling, distributed training, or resource-constrained deployments.
* Experience turning research prototypes into maintained production capabilities.

What to Include in Your Application

Please share your CV and relevant publications, repositories, or project examples. Where possible, include:

* An LLM fine-tuning or compression project with measured quality, memory, and latency results.
* An agentic code-generation system you personally built, including its tool integrations and evaluation approach.
* A brief explanation of your individual contribution and the most significant technical problem you solved.
* Your current notice period and availability to work from the office.

title: Sr Analyst, Asst Engagement Manager, Engagement Manager -Data Science
description:
**URGENT HIRING DATA SCIENCE - Chennai**

  

A leading **global healthcare consulting firm** specializing in global market research, advanced analytics and data-driven business solutions.

  

The organization has its headquarters in Princeton, New Jersey, with offices in Chennai and Hyderabad, and offers an excellent opportunity to work on challenging global healthcare and pharmaceutical analytics projects.

  

**Job Location: Chennai Only**  
Candidates from anywhere in India who are willing to relocate to Chennai may apply.

  

Open Positions

1. **Sr. Analyst Data Science:** 2-4 years
2. **Associate Engagement Manager Data Science:** 5-7 years
3. **Engagement Manager Data Science:** 7- 11 years

  

**Key Skills Required**

  

**Python | SQL | Machine Learning | ML Modelling | Hadoop | Hive | HUE | Advanced Analytics | Predictive Modelling**

Knowledge of NLP, Generative AI (GenAI), LLMs and production-grade ML models will be an added advantage.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Apply advanced statistical analysis, predictive analytics and machine learning techniques to solve complex business problems in the healthcare and pharmaceutical domains.
* Develop, validate and implement **production-grade machine learning models** to identify patterns, predict outcomes and generate actionable business insights.
* Use Python and SQL extensively for data processing, extraction, transformation, aggregation, statistical analysis and visualization.
* Work with large datasets using Hadoop, Hive and HUE, including querying, storing and retrieving data as required.
* Explore and analyse pharmaceutical datasets, identify trends and influencing factors, and prepare high-quality analytical reports and management consulting presentations.
* Develop charts, graphs, tables and visual summaries to communicate analytical findings and business recommendations effectively.
* Prepare analysis plans in collaboration with team leads and project teams, ensuring appropriate methodologies and timely project execution.
* Explain complex statistical concepts and technical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translate insights into practical business solutions.
* Guide team members in adopting advanced data science technologies, analytical methodologies and automation techniques to improve productivity and efficiency.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, quality and consistency across all analytical deliverables.
* For managerial roles, plan and allocate work, coordinate team activities, monitor progress, review deliverables and ensure timely completion.
* Develop, update and implement standard operating procedures for data analysis, quality control and consistent project delivery.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Full-time degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) or a relevant discipline. An MBA in Marketing, Operations Research, Data Science or Business Analytics will be an advantage.
* **Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Advanced Analytics using Python and SQL**.
* Strong practical experience in statistical analysis, quantitative modelling, predictive analytics and machine learning.
* Experience in developing and evaluating ML models; practical exposure to Natural Language Processing (NLP), LLMs and Generative AI is desirable.
* Working knowledge of solution design, analytical planning, execution and business problem-solving.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is preferred.
* People management, team coordination and client-facing experience are desirable, particularly for managerial positions.

Additional Skills Preferred

* **Programming & Analytics:** Base SAS, Advanced SAS, Python scripting and VBA Macros.
* **Data Platforms & ML Tools:** Snowflake, Dataiku and Azure ML Studio.
* **Visualization & Reporting:** Power BI, Tableau, MS Excel, think-cell and Qlik Sense.
* **Emerging Technologies:** NLP, Generative AI and LLM-based analytical solutions.

  

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant Data Science/Advanced Analytics experience are requested to share their updated CV.

**Contact Person:** Abhranshu DasGupta  
**Email:** adasgupta@axmiyanhr.com  
**WhatsApp CV:** 9584917778

**Important:** Chennai is the only job location. Candidates must be willing to relocate to Chennai.

Please mention the position applied for, total experience, relevant Data Science experience, current location, current CTC, expected CTC and notice period while sharing your CV.
